book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Nhwano ghwa nhakila ywa maha
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, ywohele ywakayingila ng'obhe mulubhigho lwa mene kwa kupitila palitatilo, peni pakayingila kwa kupitila pamoo pangi, aywo mwihi na mpoki.
Peni mundu ywakayingilila kupitila palitatilo aywo ndo nhakila ywa mene.
Nkingikiha ywa litatilo kangunhughulila litatilo nhakila aywo, na mene bhanguyihwa lilobhe lyake, naywo kanguakema kila yumu na lihina lyake, na kuapiha panji ya lubhigho.
Pakaapiha panji, kangulongola kuulongolo ghwabhe nabho mene bhanguntughila, kiyaha bhangulimanya lilobhe lyake.
Peni Mene bhatantughila ng'obhe nhenja, ngati bhatantugha kiyaha bhangulimanya ng'obhe lilobhe lyake.”
Yesu kakiaghombela nhwano aghwo, peni bhombe bhakighumanya ng'obhe kila kyakakipalite kuaghombela.
Yesu ndo nhakila ywa maha
Hino, Yesu kakiaghombela kangi, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, nenga ndo litatilo lya mene.
Bhala bhangi bhoha bhaahikite pakali ya nenga ndo abhwihi na apoka, na mene bhakiayihwa ng'obhe.
Nenga ndo hando litatilo. Ywoheli ywakayingila kupitila kwa nenga katalopoka, kaayingila na kupita panji na katamokola kyohele kyakakipala.
Mwihi kanguhika kwa likaho lya kuyibha, kukoma na kuhanyanga. Nenga hika ngati mmeghe na ubhumi mbole mmeghe naghwo ngenyu.”
“Nenga ndo nhakila ywa maha, Nhakila ywa maha kabhegha kala kuhwegha kwakya mene bhake.
Mundu ywakatenda lihengo lya kuhakila mene ili kahombwe ngalabha, ywene mene chepa bha ywombe, pakammona kabhwa bha kunhitu kanguhika katatugha, na kataaleka mene na kupwilinganika ku mbande hyoha.
Ywombe kangutugha kiyaha ndo mundu ywa kuhombwa ngalabha ghweka, hangi milando ya mene kwa ywombe ndo kilibhi ng'obhe.
Nenga ndo nhakila ywa maha, nunguamanya mene bhangu na mene bhangu bhangumanya nenga.
Handa bhula Tate pakamanya nenga na nenga mununmanya Tate. Na mmegha kala kuhwegha ili mene bhakotoke kuhobha.
Kangi megha na mene bhangi bhene chepa bha lubhigho alu. Yingunogha nubhayeghe bhubho, nabho bhatayihwa lilobhe lyangu, mbole kwabhegha lumati lumu na nhakila yumu.”
“Tate ghwangu kangumbala kiyaha mmegha kala kuhwegha ili mbole hotole kubhegha na ubhumi kangi.

Kahone mundu ywa kumuhila ubhumi ghwangu, peni nenga mbala numwene kughubhuha ubhumi ghwangu. Nenga megha na makakala gha kuubhuha ubhumi ghwangu, kangi megha na makakala gha kuubhuyiha kangi. Ngwiliho ayi kambegha Tate ywangu niyitende.”
Paayihwite malagho agha Akaayahudi bhakighabhanika kangi.
Ayoloho mu bhombe bhakilongela, “Ayu Kabhegha na lindilo! Kangi kabhegha na nng'uluka! Kiyaha niki mungunnyihwa?”
Bhangi bhakilongela, “Agha chepa malagho gha mundu ywakabhegha na lindilo, yuna lindilo kaahotola kuahughula bhangalola?”
Yesu kangulemwa na Akaayahudi
Akwo ku Yelusalemu kukibhegha na Kikubhukubhu kya kukulungwa kuyohwa Nyumba ya Chapanga, manjubha aghwo ghukibhegha nndaluko ghwa malili.
Naywo Yesu kakibhegha kangutyanga ku nyumba ya Chapanga mu ludamu lwa Sulemani.
Akaayahudi bhakintindila na kunkonya, “Ghungutuleka mu bhwaghalihi mbaka pakiki? Handa ghwenga ndo Kilisito Nkombohi, ghutughombele tumanye?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Nikibhaghombela, peni mwenga mukinyubhalila ng'obhe. Mahengo ghanughatenda kwa likalama lya lihina lya Tate ywangu ghangubhoneha kukita nenga ndo ghani,
peni mwenga mungunyubhalila ng'obhe kiyaha mwenga ndo bhakimati kyangu ng'obhe kya mene.
Mene bhangu bhanguyihwa lilobhe lyangu, nunguamanya, na bhombe bhangundughila.
Nenga nunguapegha ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha, nabho bhahobha ng'obhe. Kahone mundu ywa kubhabhuha mumabhoko ghangu.
Tate ywangu ywakambeghite mene abha ndo nkulu kupitingana kwa bhoha, hangi kahone mundu ywakubhabhuha mu mabhoko gha Tate ghwangu.
Nenga na Tate ndo kilibhi kimu.”
Ndo Akaayahudi bhakilokota malibho ngati bhanng'ume na kunkoma.
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nubhalaha mihabho miyoloho mikulu kuhuma kwa Tate ghwangu. Ndo nhabho ghwoki nkaki ya ayo ghunguatenda mungome?”
Ayahudi bhakinnyanga, “Tungughughuma ng'obhe malibho kwa mahengo gha maha, ngati kiyaha ghungukundula. Mana ghungulitenda ghwenga Chapanga kunu ghwenga ghu mundu handa bhandu bhangi.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Yityekwa ng'obhe mu malaghilo kukita, Chapanga kakilongela ‘Mwenga ndo machapanga.’
Handa Chapanga kakiakema machapanga bhala bhakabhalaghilite lilagho lyake, na twenga tungumanya kukita manjubha ghoha malembo gha Chapanga ghangulongela hoto.
Yibheghaki mungulongela kukita yula ywakahaghulitwe na Tate na kunnlaghila munnima kukita kangukundula? Bhuli, kiyaha nenga nikilongela ndo Mwana ywa Chapanga?
Handa ningutenda ng'obhe lihengo lya Tate ywangu, hino nkotoke kunyubhalila.

Peni handa nungutenda lihengo lya Tate ywangu, hata handa mungunyubhalila ng'obhe, hino mughahyubhalile agho mahengo, ili mmokole kumanya na kung'amula kukita Tate kabhegha nkati ya nenga na nenga megha nkati ya Tate.”
Bhakiyigha kangi kunkamula, peni Yesu kakihepetuka mumabhoko ghabhe.
Yesu kakighenda kangi kumwambo ya lukemba Yoldani, mbaka pala pakabheghite Yohane kangubatisa apo kandahi, naywo kakitama akwo.
Bhandu ayoloho bhakinng'endela na bhakilongela. “Yohane kakitenda ng'obhe nhabho ghwohele, peni milando hyoha yakalongilite Yohane kunninga mundu ayu yibhegha hoto.”
Na bhandu ayoloho bhaabheghite kula bhakinnyubhalila Yesu.
